notes:
### Dorcel Recovery Integration

- Unlimited, 15, 30, 60 and 120 minute Dorcel checks now use the same current shadow/outage recovery path.
- The obsolete v1.142 proactive/reactive path and the disabled predictive five-minute experiment have been removed instead of remaining as dormant fallback code.

### Unlimited Stop Handling

- The shared Site/IPTV Unlimited guard now distinguishes an explicit user Stop from Ended/Error events, suppresses controlled internal handoffs and gives automatic EOF/error a recovery window plus Check Lock restore fallback instead of falsely saving the log and shutting down.

### Site / IPTV Alignment

- PVR_COM_SITE shares the same PVR_COM diagnostic path, so the duration-independent Dorcel recovery and generic Unlimited stop fix also apply to Site One Channel checks.

### Important

- Normal SOURCE_WINDOW thresholds, live-delay behavior and the planned hourly Dorcel token handoff remain unchanged.
